balls.text: ends the innings with a perfect yorker, Rohit jams down the bat on it and trots out, Faulkner rushes forward, picks it up and removes the bail with Rohit far out
Faulkner pitches it up after that bouncer, and even though it swings away, Rohit clears front leg again and is in a position to drill it into the straight boundary
Faulkner pings in a sharp bouncer that comes in around head height, Rohit swings and misses
a length ball, Rohit gets under it , clears front leg and lifts it over long off
does not work against Rohit, Faulkner full outside leg again, Rohit opens up a bit and crashes it over deep midwicket
that is the same ploy from Faulkner to Pollard as well, full just outside leg with some swing, Pollard swings and misses once more
keeps Pollard quiet throughout the over with another full delivery outside leg stump, Pollard cannot connect yet again
goes full around leg to Pollard again, he tries the reverse paddle, it hits the toe end and pops up behind square on the leg side
Rohit slogs at a length ball, mishits to deep midwicket
decides to bowl it short now, and Rohit pulls it from around stomach height over deep square leg
another full ball into the pad, Pollard is making room but cannot connect
low full toss from round the stumps flicked to deep midwicket
more late away swing on this full delivery to end the over, but this time Rohit follows it to guide it to point
Rohit tries to swipe this over square leg, the ball flies in the air between the keeper and short third man
now he beats Rohit, who makes room outside leg, Faulkner follows him there, and generates some more late swing to beat the bat
comes outside the crease again but cannot get bat to ball on this pitched up delivery, Faulkner shouts for leg before, just in case
beats him with a full delivery that moves away late in the air, and almost hits the off stump
Pollard comes down the track, inside edges in front of square, Faulkner goes after it, but they have time to take the second
Cooper gets away, third man is up, he bowls one more full toss outside off, Rohit steers it with nice timing, but picks the fielder
comes down the track and swings hard, but this is an offcutter, and comes in to beat him
Cooper bowls another full toss, outside off, Rohit smashes it over the deep extra cover boundary
charges out and heaves, only manages an inside edge to the left of the keeper, Samson gathers, throws and hits the stumps, but Rohit has just made it back
a slower shortish delivery, Rohit is surprised by the lift and lack of pace, and is beaten
a full toss, but Pollard inside edges it on to pad as he looks to hit it square on leg
more runs, Rohit bends forward for the paddle and executes it neatly from around off, picks up four to the fine leg rope
opens the face and guides a length ball to point
next ball Pollard charges out and heaves it high, it is a mishit, but just clears the long on boundary

clear run-out chance missed, Pollard had no chance of making it  back after coming too far down, midwicket picked up the ball and fired it to the keeper, who broke the stumps, but before that, he let the ball slip out of his gloves
opens the face on the leg cutter to guide it to point and takes the single, there is a direct hit but Pollard is home, almost past the stumps
comes in to around off stump, Rohit pushes forward and trots out, has to hurry back as the ball goes to point
two wickets in the over, Hussey tries to go a bit straighter with the slog sweep, this is bowled wide outside off and he has to fetch it, ends up finding long on, Cooper it is again
lots of turn, angles it to leg and turns it across the batsman, Pollard nudges it towards point
sweeps in front of square from just outside off

they finally break the partnership, Ankit tosses it up, Simmons skips out and lofts it, he isn't quite to the pitch, and the ball spins away from him, Cooper settles under the skier in front of the sightscreen
makes some room, but slaps it straight to extra cover
moves back to a length ball on middle and off and works it behind square leg
beaten as he pushes at a length ball outside off
shortish, pulled behind square leg
he's hit gaps so well today, this is full on off, he drills it through extra cover, Chand puts in the dive at long off to deny him the boundary
wide outside off again, cut to sweeper cover for a single
goes much wider on a length, Simmons reaches it and stabs it wide of the sweeper
Simmons goes maximum first ball of the over, Cooper pitches it up just outside off and Simmons clears front leg to clobber it over long off
Hussey tries the reverse paddle to a full one just outside off, but misses
winds up and has another slog at a full one outside off, underedges it
pitched up on middle and leg, driven down to long off
quicker and in the blockhole, Simmons swipes, inside-edges behind square leg
Bhatia bowls it at 96 kph, Simmons backs away and slogs, connects well enough to hit it way over deep midwicket
Simmons moves outside leg and cracks this length ball, Watson dives to his left at extra cover and gets a hand to it
now he backs away to leg and pulls hard, deep midwicket runs to his left to cut it off
straightening on middle, Simmons cannot force it past the bowler
that turned, was angled in well down leg as Simmons moved away as well, then changed direction sharply to almost hit leg stump, Simmons beaten by a long way
chops the cut close to the pitch and takes the single to reach fifty in his IPL match since April 27
Hussey slog-sweeps, takes it from outside off, it flies 79 metres into the crowd in front of square
gets some width from the left arm spinner and cuts through point, easy couple as sweeper runs around
Hussey times another drive through the off side, extra cover dives, takes pace off it
hurls it full into the pad, Hussey misses the clip, trots out for a single, but Faulkner rushes forward to prevent that
steps down the track but Faulkner digs it short, too short it turns out
makes some room and slogs down to long on
whips a length delivery to deep square leg
denies him width this time, Hussey nudges to midwicket
starts with a slow back of a length ball cutting away outside off, Hussey sends it soaring over deep midwicket with a solid pull
Hussey is managing to time nearly everything on this slow pitch, now he waits and punches a length ball just past extra cover
and Bhatia almost gets Simmons again, he had walked out, Bhatia bowled his leg roller, and it bounced and moved away, Simmons pushed and it popped just wide of the bowler to his left
overpitched, Hussey drills it straight past the bowler, long on runs around to field
Simmons stands outside leg, Bhatia's delivery takes its time in arriving at 88 kph, Simmons almost hits it back to the bowler, just past his left to long off
turned in front of square on leg off the pad
almost plays on, he had backed away to leg and taken a swipe at this full delivery, thick inside edged it behind square on leg in the end
down to third man who runs to his right and keeps them to one
Hussey skips out as Kulkarni pitches it up from round the stumps, he lofts to the right of long off, Faulkner almost over runs the ball, but gets a hand to it to prevent the boundary
this slow bouncer rises quite high on Hussey, he swivels and checks the hook, just guides it down to fine leg in the end
width on the length ball, Simmons slaps it to the sweeper
almost carries to sweeper cover as Hussey lofts this full delivery, gets to Binny on the bounce
worked off the pad through square leg
the pitch may be slow, but the outfield is very fast, Hussey opens the face and punches in the gap between backward point and short third man, and both the men have no chance in the chase
a length ball coming in at 92 kph, pushed to long on
cannot get this one around off away, Bhatia fields on the off side
a loop, slow, dipping, low full toss from Bhatia, Simmons leans out to softly push towards long on, and Hussey scrambles back for the second
starts with a pitched up ball on the pad and is worked through midwicket
Hussey goes to the left of the sweeper now with a front foot drive to this widish length ball, and this time he's hit it well enough to beat the man by a fair distance
tries to pull a good length delivery, mishits to midwicket
Hussey opens the face and drives a pitched up ball through point, sweeper has some running to do
pitches it up, Simmons moves forward and pushes it to the sweeper past point
third man is up, this is short, wide and cutting further away, Simmons dabs it in the gap between short third and backward point quite easily
starts on a good length outside off, Hussey pushes it to third man with an open face
softly pushes a 117 kph length ball on leg to the off side for a single
slower one dragged down to long on
low full toss driven to mid off
confounds him now with a slow bouncer cutting in, Simmons fends at it awkwardly in the end, and is beaten, it is called a no-ball for being above shoulder height, harsh call
bouncer, climbs high outside off, Simmons hops and tries to upper-cut, misses
Simmons is hitting 'em hard, Cooper overpitches outside off, and Simmons moves forward to smash it past extra cover
starts with a length ball angling across to off, is dabbed down to third man
Faulkner goes into the blockhole, and Simmons can only jab it to mid off even as he backs away again
and again, Simmons makes plenty of room outside leg stump now and slices the drive in the air, through the gap at point
there is not much pace available off the pitch, so Simmons cranks up to this length ball and thumps it past backward point's dive
again the ball does not come on and Hussey drags the pull to deep square
Faulkner goes short, into the left hander, Hussey tries to pull, misses, and is hit
shot, Hussey is stepping out first ball, and places the drive through the small gap at extra cover
could have been close as Simmons worked a slower one to midiwicket and only Hussey took off, fielder was on to it but Hussey turned back in time
slower one cutting across to middle from outside leg, worked wristily to deep square leg
works up some pace and bounce from short of a length, but the line is down the leg side
overpitched and slanted across, Hussey drives nicely but cannot beat extra cover
tries to smash the back of a length delivery through the off side, had lots of room, but it is difficult to time on this slow pitch, extra cover fields
Simmons sees it start on a similar line and sets up for a big shot again, but this is the slower one, it cuts in and takes a thick inside edge onto pad
Kulkarni provides some width early in the over, and Simmons cuts hard past backward point, third man is up in the circle, not that he would have had much chance had he been deep
backs away outside leg and drives to wide long off
hits Simmons on the forearm with some bounce as he misses the sweep, couple of quick shouts for leg before turned down
this is going down the leg side and Hussey nudges it to the left of short fine leg, where Bhatia's dive is clumsy and futile
Hussey connects with the reverse sweep off this full delivery on the stumps, but hits it straight to short third man
moves down the track, bowler angles it in, and Simmons turns it to deep midwicket
takes this full ball from just outside off and works it to deep midwicket
Kulkarni ends the over with a slow bouncer, at 114 kph, Simmons is already setting himself up for the pull, he waits and then drags it past short fine leg from around chest height
second appeal of the over for lbw but it is headed down leg once more, Simmons caught on the crease and missing the tuck to leg
Simmons charges out again but Kulkarni bowls an offcutter and he cannot find any timing as he flays at it
Kulkrani raises his hand in appeal but this length ball was slipping down leg with the angle, also hit him high above the knee roll
steps down the track now, Kulkarni bowls it widish and it swings further away from a length to beat Simmons' swish
moves across and pushes a good length ball to the off side
he clips it off the pad to the left of deep midwicket, they decide to go for the second after an instant's thought, and make it comfortably
angles it full into the pad and it is worked to deep midwicket
on the front foot to defend back to the bowler
makes room outside leg but this is almost yorker length as he squeezes it out to cover
punched to cover off the back foot
a tossed up full ball is whipped out to deep midwicket for a single
wide short of a length delivery, he dabs it to third man for a single
Bhatia done in by the lack of pace on this length ball, tries to dab it but misses
high full toss, Bhatia heaves, thick edge flies past the keeper on the off side
full again outside off, hit through cover for one
drives a full one outside off to sweeper cover
scythes a full toss to the sweeper
a slower length ball pushed to cover for a single
Hodge starts walking down the track even as Santokie runs in to bowl, Hodge stops and slogs, but the connection is not good enough, and Rohit hops to take it at wide long on
six more, a low full toss, Hodge moves outside off and slogs it over long on
full outside leg stump now, Faulkner misses, the ball rolls behind square on off
now he goes over extra cover, Santokie goes full outside off, and Faulkner clears front leg to slam it out of Pollard's reach at long off
Faulkner sends the first ball of the over, an away swinging length ball outside off, a long way over the long off boundary
swings and misses a pitched up ball as it comes in with the angle outside off
Hodge finally connects to a wide length ball and mows it over long on
not happening for RR, Faulkner drives a wide and full one, along the ground, to extra cover
bowls it too far outside off this time
another wide slower one, Hodge's heave results in a thick inside edge to short fine leg
a wide, slow length ball, Hodge has a big heave at it but misses
slogs a full delivery past the bowler, Rohit runs across from long off and fumbles, Faulkner rushes back for the second
Faulkner gets one away, he slogs this flat towards long on, there is no Pollard there this time, Rohit jumps but it clears him comfortably
guides a full ball outside off to short third man
away swinging full toss hit wide of the sweeper
hurls it way outside off stump with the angle
low full toss squeezed to the left of the sweeper for a couple
hits a length delivery to extra cover
slow length ball outside off, slapped to covers for a single
backs away but cannot do anything more than slap the length delivery through cover for one
punched off the back foot to long off
mistimes the cut towards point, will get only a single
comes in towards middle and leg, he makes room and punches to long off
pulls a length ball on off to deep midwicket
quick delivery just outside off, he cuts to cover who lets it slip through
cut to sweeper cover for a couple
slices a heave in front of long off, Pollard runs forward but cannot reach it in time
goes outside off now, Hodge cuts it to sweeper cover
full on leg stump, Hodge slog-sweeps into the crowd over deep midwicket
in the blockhole now, squeezed back past the non-striker
legbreak spins away outside off, Hodge helps it to the sweeper for one
excellent delivery, tosses it up close to off, draws him forward, and it does not turn in, goes straight past the outside edge
bowled much slower on a length outside off, tapped in front of square for one
slogs at a fullish one, wide of deep square leg for a couple, Rayudu stops it with a slide
leans forward to work it past midwicket
flat offbreak outside off, turned to midwicket
tossed up slowly and dips full, he comes forward and opens the face to run it behind point
quicker and fuller, pushed wide of point for a quick single
has a heave at a flighted legbreak outside off and is beaten by the turn
tossed up wrong 'un wide outside off, pushed off the front foot to the sweeper
has him reaching to a spinning delivery, thick outside edge runs past slip
goes back to punch a legbreak to the bowler

Karun falls, he comes down the track to a flighted one, nowhere to the pitch as it dips, tries to go straight over the bowler, but mishits it badly, Santokie runs in from long off and tumbles forward to take it
Karun still going strong, he gets down on a knee outside off stump and sweeps with the spin high over short fine
tosses it up high and full, it is worked through midwicket
another one pings the pad, and Harbhajan's appeal turned down again, possibly outside the line once more
hits the pad on the forward push with sharp turn, shout for leg before, but he is outside the line
punched off the back foot to deep point
goes back to a pitched up ball to push to mid off
full delivery does not turn, Hodge steers it to point
excellent from the legspinner to get his Karnataka team-mate, he continues to flight it outside off, Binny charges out and heaves, is beaten by the sharp turn and it is an easy stumping
this one is tossed up high and full and turns away from his big attempted drive
comes down the track to one that does not turn much, and swats it to extra cover
full outside off, turned to midwicket with the spin
tossed up outside off, inside edged off the front foot to the leg side
a fuller one, he comes forward and is hit on the pad again, another shout but he was outside the line
quick and spinning in, worked to midwicket
appeal for lbw as he is hit on the pad with a fuller one
offbreak spins in sharply from outside off and hits the thigh pad
stays low from a good length around off, worked to deep midwicket
a tossed up full googly, pushed down the track, bowler fields to his right with a dive
straightens just outside off, is cut to point
Rajasthan crumbling, Ankit Sharma slog-sweeps from around off and deep midwicket comes a few steps forward to his left to take it
a flatter one outside off, he cuts well in front of square, Hussey prevents the boundary
misses the sweep as this fuller one spins down the leg side
Gopal starts with a short legbreak, it is pulled between deep midwicket and long on, but not enough on it to beat the men
full again, reverse swept straight to point
full outside off, pushed to the bowler

what an incredible sequence this is, Pollard leaps high to take a one-handed screamer at long on as Cooper swats a shortish delivery, Pollard staggers to the ground, takes a couple of steps towards the boundary, the second one is probably millimetres away from the rope, he throws the ball up as he goes over, then runs back several feet, and dives forward to complete the catch, given after they check with the third umpire
another one down the leg side, Cooper swings and connects, gets it wide of short fine leg, deep square runs around to stop it
way down the leg side, Cooper has a crack at it, misses
sliding across the right hander from a length, Cooper is beaten on the cut
tossed up full one leg, pushed down the track
now he goes back to cut from close to off, sweeper runs to his left, it is a tight second, but he makes it
shout of 'catch it' as Karun lunges forward on a knee to hit a flat sweep, but it flies well over the man at deep square leg
thick outside edge as he drives, Santokie dives at short third man to stop it
comes across and works it through vacant midwicket for a couple
has a heave at a tossed up ball  but is beaten by a long way with the sharp turn, Tare appeals for the stumping but Cooper's back foot is grounded
plays a tossed up ball off the back foot, pushes it to point
difficult chance running back from mid on as batsman skies a slog, Gopal does well to get to the ball as it comes down from behind him, but cannot pouch it
floats it up slow and way outside off
gets down for the sweep and connects off the length ball, but finds square leg
punches a good length ball to long off
another one goes, Samson tries going over the off-side infield, but he is nowhere in control as the slower one cuts away from him, he slices the mishit, Rayudu runs back from cover and takes it
a slower one, good length, angling across, he is beaten as he pushes at it
a length ball down the leg side nudged behind square
it straightens just outside off, he punches from the crease to point
quicker on middle, he backs away and cuts to cover
goes back to a pitched up delivery but is able to punch through the covers for a couple
walks to off and tries a big sweep to a full ball, underedges it to short fine leg
he sees the chance to pull this shortish ball, but it spins away and bounces, and he toe ends it for mid on to take a simple catch to his right
Watson is looking for a big shot, but pushes the length ball to mid on in the end
what a strike, he charges out to a length ball and mows it into the crowd beyond the long on boundary
not too much room to cut but Karun times the shot, Hussey stops it on the bounce at backward point
comes forward to an incoming ball, it runs square on the leg side
fuller from Pollard and wide too, Watson cuts hard, not too far from Rayudu at backward point, but he lets it rush past
short of a length again, punched to extra cover
short of a length, just outside off, pushed to the bowler
some more width on a length from Ojha and Karun goes back to cut in front of square for four more

not the best effort at point from Harbhajan as Karun cuts hard, he runs to his right, square leg umpire is close by, perhaps that is why Harbhajan slides too early, and by the time he recovers and gets up to chase, the ball rolls into the boundary
goes outside off, and dabs it with the spin past slip, short third man chases
they have Hussey at deep midwicket, Chand pulls a short of a length delivery, Hussey runs and tumbles forward to complete the catch
shortish ball slapped to extra cover
goes for a big sweep to a full ball straightening on off, thick inside-edges to backward square
Karun gets it over the infield again, Santokie slants it on a length across him, and he wristily picks it just over Pollard's leap at point
a slower one bowled full on off, pushed to midwicket
a full toss, Karun Nair moves outside leg stump, and slices it over the infield, it goes all the way over the deep point boundary
would have been another wide down leg had he not nudged it to short fine leg
pitched up inswinger hits the pad, and rolls to the keeper
swings it in but it starts outside leg and moves further down
starts on a length outside leg stump, is worked square
pushes away from the body at a widish length ball and it goes to third man
bowls it much straighter but it starts way outside off
swings again and gets a thick inside edge towards short fine leg now
he bowls it fuller now, angles it in again, Chand tries a big drive and misses, the ball almost hits off
he looks to punch through point, but it comes in sharply from outside off, and beats the inside edge
comes in sharply with the angle, Chand pushes it towards point
short of a length, coming in from wide outside off, guided to third man
